project_name.justification: The documents consistently refer to the project as the Northshore Gold Project. For example: "Newpath Enters LOI to Sell Northshore Gold Project" and "Great Eagle Gold Corp. Announces LOI to Acquire Patented Mineral Rights Titles Containing NI 43-101 Certified Gold Resources... part of a larger claims package collectively known as the 'Northshore Gold Property.'"

company_name.justification: Great Eagle Gold Corp. is identified as the acquirer. "Newpath Resources Inc. (CSE: PATH) ... is pleased to announce that Great Eagle Gold Corp. ("Great Eagle") has completed its due diligence on the Company's Northshore Gold Project."

ceo_buyer.justification: Andrew Fletcher is identified as the CEO of the acquiring company, Great Eagle Gold Corp. "On behalf of the board, Andrew Fletcher, CEO & Director Great Eagle Gold Corp."

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement is for a 100% interest in the property. "Great Eagle has the option to acquire a 100% interest in the patented claims of the Northshore Gold Property from Newpath." and confirmed in a later release: "it has entered into a definitive agreement with New Path Resources Inc. ... to acquire a 100% interest in a mineral rights package".

primary_commodity.justification: The project is explicitly identified as a gold project. "Newpath Enters LOI to Sell Northshore Gold Project".

verified_article_link.justification: The article titled 'Newpath Enters LOI to Sell Northshore Gold Project' directly discusses the transaction for the Northshore project between Newpath Resources Inc. and Great Eagle Gold Corp.

currency.justification: The currency is specified as Canadian dollars. "The total purchase price is set at CDN$1,000,000..."

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total purchase price is the sum of all cash payments. "The total purchase price is set at CDN$1,000,000, payable as follows: $10,000 was paid within two business days of the execution of the LOI for due diligence costs. $90,000 to be paid upon execution of the definitive Transaction Agreement. The remaining $900,000 is payable on or before the first anniversary of the Transaction Agreement."

share_payments_raw.justification: The consideration is entirely in cash; no share payments are mentioned as part of the acquisition terms.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The consideration is explicitly broken down into cash payments, so this combined field is not applicable.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: No shares are being issued as part of the acquisition consideration.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants are mentioned as part of the acquisition consideration.

option_payments_raw.justification: The transaction is structured as an option to purchase, but the consideration is cash, not stock options.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares are being issued, so there is no issue price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: There is no mention of an exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: There is no mention of a monetary exploration commitment.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: As part of the transaction, the seller (Newpath) will be granted a 1.5% NSR royalty. "In the event Great Eagle modifies its plans for the project, a 1.5% NSR royalty on the patented Claims will be granted to Newpath."

coverage_area_raw.justification: The total area of the property package being acquired is stated as 940 hectares. "the Northshore Gold Property includes 3 patented claims and 38 unpatented claims covering a total area of approximately 940 hectares."

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is specified as hectares. "the Northshore Gold Property includes 3 patented claims and 38 unpatented claims covering a total area of approximately 940 hectares."

resource_size.value: 6,511,000 Tonnes | 1.15 Grade (g/t Au) | 0.40 Cut Off Grade (g/t Au) | 240,100 Total Ounces | Inferred
resource_size.justification: A clarification news release provides a detailed table of the NI 43-101 compliant gold resource: "Northshore Inferred Mineral Resource Estimate Tonnes | Grade (g/t Au) | Cut Off Grade (g/t Au) | Total Ounces | Category 6,511,000 | 1.15 | 0.40 | 240,100 | Inferred*****"

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer, Great Eagle Gold Corp., is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE) with the ticker GEGC. "Great Eagle Gold Corp. (CSE: GEGC) (OTC Pink: GEGCF) (FSE: GI8) ("Great Eagle" or the "Company")"
